evals.name: docs-via-context7
evals.prompt: React 19 的 use() hook 怎么用？给我官方文档里的用法
evals.expected_output: Routes to context7; returns cited doc excerpts with context7.com source links.

evals.name: news-hot-dsh
evals.expected_output: In DSH: qqnews hot list and/or bing news-intent query returns real current items with titles, dates and links; curl harnesses may use brave --news / tencent. Never fabricates news.

evals.name: zhihu-degradation
evals.prompt: 知乎上大家怎么看 Rust 在后端的落地？
evals.expected_output: zhihu if configured; otherwise bing site:zhihu.com fallback (curl harness: exa+brave), explicitly noting the substitution.

evals.name: broad-fanout
evals.prompt: 全面调研一下 Bun 这个 JS runtime 的现状、性能和生态
evals.expected_output: Fan-out bing+context7+hn (+exa,brave with curl); merged, deduped by URL, cited summary grouped by type.

evals.name: football-news-dsh
evals.prompt: 搜搜最新足球比赛新闻
evals.expected_output: In DSH: hupu fresh football headlines with bbs.hupu.com links + bing(q=足球 新闻) (+qqnews hot); cited Markdown with dates. This query failed in v1; must now return real results without fabrication.

evals.name: dev-repo-discovery
evals.prompt: 有什么值得看的 Rust web 框架？顺便给我一个例子项目
evals.expected_output: github repo search sorted by stars (full_name, stars, description) plus optional so/hn results; all with links.

evals.name: data-two-step
evals.prompt: 比亚迪最新销量数据是多少？
evals.expected_output: bing keyword query, then per numbers two-step direct-fetch a data page (or transparently quote a figure found in an RSS snippet). Must NOT present portal homepages as if they answered the figure; if no number found, say so plainly.

evals.name: zhihu-fallback-honesty
evals.prompt: 知乎上大家怎么看产品经理转行做AI？
evals.expected_output: zhihu if configured; else bing site:zhihu.com best-effort. If results collapse to generic 'what is 产品' definitions, report the fallback missed and degrade — never cite off-topic pages to look complete.
